title: RDS in Wrong Region

request.justification: Creating test database in us-west-2 for disaster recovery testing

expected.explanation: SCP scp-region-restrict denies resource creation outside us-east-1

teachingPoint: DR testing is important but must happen in approved regions — SCPs enforce this at the org level

title: Analyst Reads Prod Data

request.justification: Downloading monthly analytics export for executive dashboard

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits s3:GetObject in prod with confidential classification; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: Data Analysts have legitimate prod read access — not all prod access is dangerous when properly scoped

title: Security Detaches Policy

request.justification: Emergency: detaching overly permissive policy from compromised service role

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions for non-Admin roles, even in emergencies

teachingPoint: Even urgent security responses hit guardrails — this is where break-glass procedures become essential

title: Staging Bucket ACL Change

request.justification: Making staging demo bucket accessible for client preview

expected.explanation: SCP scp-deny-s3-public denies s3:PutBucketAcl for all roles

teachingPoint: Bucket ACL changes are blocked in all environments — use CloudFront or signed URLs for external access

title: Auditor CloudTrail With Ticket

request.justification: Investigating access pattern anomaly for compliance investigation

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits CloudTrail read in prod; ticket satisfies ABAC; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: All three policy layers pass: RBAC allows, ABAC ticket satisfied, guardrails don't block — full stack approval

title: Developer Creates IAM User

request.justification: Creating a service account for CI/CD pipeline automation

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Service accounts must be created by Admins — developers request them through proper channels

title: Security Reads Prod Logs

request.justification: Analyzing VPC flow logs for network security assessment

expected.explanation: Security Engineer permits S3 read in prod; internal classification needs no ticket; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: Internal classification data flows freely for Security Engineers — no ABAC ticket needed for non-restricted data

title: Intern Dev S3 Read

request.justification: Browsing training materials bucket for onboarding

expected.explanation: Intern role permits S3 read in dev with internal classification; all three policy layers pass

teachingPoint: Even with guardrails active, simple allowed actions pass through — the layers only block what they're designed to block

title: Cross-Team Staging Delete

request.justification: Core team asked me to clean up their temp files in staging

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped blocks payments team from deleting core team resources

teachingPoint: ABAC team scoping catches this before guardrails — multiple layers provide defense in depth

title: Security GuardDuty No Ticket

request.justification: Quick check on GuardDuty findings dashboard

expected.explanation: Restricted data requires a ticket ID per ABAC rule, even for Security Engineers

teachingPoint: Quick checks on restricted data still need a ticket — there are no shortcuts for the most sensitive data
